reviews.text: Hi, Nicole. Thank you for your feedback. We are grateful to have the opportunity to care for your pet.
Easy check in, spotless office, great level of care and follow up.

Would never go anywhere else. We switched to Heart and Paw a few years back after some bad experiences with a long time former vet. They are responsive, kind, nonjudgmental, and will do anything they can to keep our pets happy and safe. Including a picture of our little guy snug and sound as a snail after his appointment today

Staff was warm and welcoming, waiting room was clean and quiet.  The doctor and nurse were very patient and made our cat feel at ease before rushing to perform the exam.  It was obvious they genuinely cared.
Very good vet and staff, Jolie loved it.
You’re toooo darn expensive

I had my first appointment here for my cat today. Every member of staff was so kind and took genuine care in treating my kitty. I have been to many vets in Philly, and never experienced this level of attention at a reasonable price. Thanks to Dr. Laura Hultzapple and all staff here!
They took really good care of my cat Nikki and we're super accommodating when I needed. Just wonderful and friendly service! 😻😺 …
Amber has been wonderful and everyone is really amazing with my little dog. He’s had a good experience there.
I’m impressed with the level of care my dog received. The veterinarian was thorough, patient, and very gentle with my pet.
This location always does an amazing job with Nico! Friendly and professional team!
Hi, Maria. We are grateful to be here to care for your pet. Thank you for sharing your positive experience and trusting us with their care.

Heart and Paws was the best experience I have had with all of my animals over the years
Caring and they work with you
I highly recommend them
So grateful
Everyone that works there is so sweet and genuinely cares about your pets and you!
Hi, Choc. We are grateful to be here to care for your pet. Thank you for sharing your positive experience and trusting us with their care.
10/10 Cj is always taking care of here

This was our second visit. The girls at the front desk have been very nice, personable and professional.
Alyssa, one of the groomers, is the BEST!!! My dog absolutely hates getting his nails done. All the Vet techs that have ever tried to cut his nails have not been very successful. One tech had to stop because she felt so bad because of the distress he was experiencing.
She clearly Was cutting too short as he was bleeding everywhere.
They  have always used a muzzle ( not that he has ever bitten anyone, and I don’t think that he would, but we were nervous that he could out of instinct since he doesn’t like it). When I told Alyssa this,  she said she is going to try to do it without one. Because she said , sometimes that makes them more nervous and uncomfortable. I was shocked! Elated and a little nervous because of the unknown, but shocked because none of the techs at two different vets I brought him to, with all their experience, thought of doing that.
I was so nervous that she was going to come out and tell me that she couldn’t do it. But when she was done, she said he did great! All she needed was someone to just hold him while she used the Dremel.
He was very happy and his nails look the best they have since we adopted him.
Today I brought him in for his second Dremel experience. And I just set up his third,  five weeks from today.   I am so happy that we finally found someone that understands my boy and can accommodate him, wow, at the same time  making him so much more comfortable!
Another spectacular day at the beauty parlor with Amber . My little diva is difficult but Amber keeps her looking beautiful and the staff and Amber couldn’t be kinder !
I was very pleased with my first grooming experience at Heart & Paw with Groomer Alyssa. Teddy B. looks so handsome
I've been using Heart & Paws' services since 2022 for grooming services. The staff is professional, the facility is clean and spacious,  and I've never had a complaint.

Clean, courteous and welcoming. My dog opened up to the friendly staff right away. His doctor and nurse were very helpful and answered all my questions and communicated their concerns and care plan for him.
Hi, Jo-anna. Caring for your pet means the world to us. Thanks for letting us know about your experience.

I love Heart and Paw! Dr Laura was very kind and patient, she took the time to answer all of my questions. The facilities at East Market are gorgeous and the waiting area is very comfortable. They are so attentive and very understanding of my cat, who tends to get stressed out during vet visits. Their online portal is also very straightforward and helpful. I definitely recommend Heart and Paw to any pet owner :)
Amber is amazing and my dog love getting groomed by her, we will be sad to see her go!

Always a good experience here. You can schedule without having to wait for weeks, appointments run on time, they really care about your pet, and everyone - from vets to techs to reception - is friendly and totally on top of things. Prices seem in line with other vet/grooming services in center city
We are grateful for you. Thank you for allowing us to care for your pet and for taking the time to share thoughts about your experience.
They are amazing! My puppy loves visiting the groomer. They do an excellent job!
We are grateful for the opportunity to care for your pet. Thank you for sharing thoughts about your experience.
Thank you so much for sharing your thoughts and for trusting us to care for your pet! We are here for you.

My boys absolutely love Heart + Paw! We’ve been going to the East Market location since their soft opening during COVID. Baskota started with play and had the time of his life! When Sankoori joined us later that year, everyone there went above and beyond to help him with his fears and bring him out of his shell.

The vets and vet techs are phenomenal. Our visits are smooth (even when I showed up to our wellness appointment last week with both boys in a boot on a knee scooter and 2 friends to help me - 1 for each pup).

The boys love every member of the East-Market team. They are patient, compassionate, friendly, and well-versed in the nuances of their various roles. I love how much they care about and how well they care for the pets under their charge.

Update (May 2026): 3 years since my last update post, and 6 years since we started going there, still our favorite vet!

When It Comes To Grooming My Baby Girl, Diva Couture,  A Maltese Poodle, I Couldn't Have Received Better Service!  Excellence In Service Started Upon Entering Heart & Paw/Ludlow, Where Diva & I Were Greeted With Warmth, Professionalism, Care & A Sense Of Family!  My Assigned Groomer Was Nothing Short Of Excellence!  Her Bonding With Diva & I Was Amazing!  She Took The Time To Build A Repore With Diva, While Analyzing Her Grooming Needs, Listening To What I Wanted Done For Diva Grooming,  While Offering Super Suggestions & Explaining What Is Covered In The Package & If Anything Extra Was Needed.  She Wanted The Best For My Diva & Did Just That!!  Alyssa Dominguez, Thank You For Doing & Being You!  Because Of Your Attention, Warmth & Professionalism, Diva & I Are NOW Heart & Paw FAMILY!  Diva Looks Amazing & It's All Because Of You & Heart & Paw!!!!!
Hi, Allie. We appreciate your feedback and thank you for trusting us to care for your pet!

Amazing staff that truly cares about their patients/animal babies. They are very thorough and dedicated to what they do and it shows. They follow up, explain everything well and are very upfront about the payment which is really helpful. I appreciate all of the staff and what they do!
Very affordable
Staff was amazing right from the start ! The nurse and doctor explained everything perfectly
We are grateful for you. Thank you for allowing us to care for your pet and for taking the time to share thoughts about your experience.
Fast grooming (nail trim) and compassionate and kind staff!
We are grateful for the opportunity to care for your pet. Thank you for sharing thoughts about your experience.

The front desk, nurse, and vets were wonderful. They took the best care of my cat and helped him feel safe. They recognized exactly when to pause to let him be less stressed and took as much time as he needed.
Thank you so much for sharing your thoughts and for trusting us to care for your pet! We are here for you.
Thanks pal. He will look great for the wedding! 👍🏼😀
Heart + Paw always takes great care of my dog, Macy. This is by far the best location for dog grooming in Philadelphia. Amber is always kind and gentle.
Hi, Victoria. We appreciate your feedback and thank you for trusting us to care for your pet!

This review is long overdue, but Heart + Paw helped me during a last-minute move to a different country 1.5 years ago (10yo cat). Every single staff member was so warm and helpful. I was in a bit of a time crunch but from the rabies vaccine to titer exam and certificates, everything was done professionally and expeditiously. From experience and research, I was worried about the costs but the pricing for everything was actually pretty fair!

Thank you for being so patient, informative, and on top of everything every step of the way! And the biggest thanks for always handling old man Charles with love!

Dr. Torres and her entire team are incredible. They make the most anxious appointments feel comfortable, and the love they show my dog means everything. I fully trust Dr. Torres with Bull’s care. I’ve never had this level of trust in a vet before. She’s extremely professional and knowledgeable.

Isiah is a great groomer...excellent service!

My small dog is well taken care of by Heart & Paw
Everyone was friendly and caring and very professional
It was a great experience all around. Amber did a wonderful job. It was our first time and we will be back our little. Eli looks fabulous.
Hi, Trish. We are grateful to be here to care for your pet. Thank you for sharing your positive experience and trusting us with their care.

This is the best grooming service I have ever used. My dog looks great. The groomer treats the dogs with kindness. The shop is extremely comfortable if you want to wait for your dog while it's getting groomed. So you don't need to run back and forth in the weather.  Scheduling is easy. It's a good price too.
I'm changing from my old groomer to Hearts and Paws . I get my dog groomed every 4 weeks. Now I finally have a comfortable place for both me and my dog to go to.

All of the people who work here are very sweet and gentle with my kitten. I just got her fixed and even though she was not happy about it they handled her with care and were available to answer any questions. Had nothing but good experiences with them.

I have a Samoyed, so they are expensive to groom, but the price was still the most I’ve paid for grooming.  HOWEVER, they groomed him so well, it made me wonder if I’ve ever gotten my dog groomed before.  My mind is blown with how good of a job they did.  Expensive but worth it!
Everyone was great with my dog! We had a really good experience

Heart + Paw always takes such good care of my baby, and they are always so excited when my cat gets a clean bill of health. It's nice to be able to trust that they're not just prescribing meds and ordering procedures to make money off you, which has become WAY too common in the industry as of late. You can tell the staff genuinely loves the work they do, and the clientele they get to serve.
Never thought about the kind of service these humans brought to us. Above and beyond.  All the blessings for them from Hachi and me

Great experience starting form the first phone call. Excellent staff everyone is super friendly
Thank you for taking care of our furbaby

Exceptionally dedicated staff who was willing to deal with all my pet owner overprotective questions. They were a bit behind before my appointment but they didn’t let that stop them from making sure every pet got the care they needed. Only took them about 8 minutes to give vaccinations and trim my cats nails. The wellness exam was detailed and quick which left me feeling relieved.

Kind, attentive to the needs of myself and my cat. Super clean, even provided cat treats, met people entering and they had huge smiles. The staff are exceptional, speaking to both myself and Sapphire my cat making sure we both felt comfortable and safe. Would definitely return for any needs or concerns...customer service is 10/10...everything was provided in paper and email format...I got business cards as well...
Clean and very lovely staff
thanks to dr. hutzapple for helping with usda health certificate and forms required for international moving of my cat - I really needed the help I got

Amber gave my pup the first grooming of his life and did an incredible job. The whole team was amazing. They seemed to sanitize the floors every few minutes and/or after a pet came in and moved throughout the space, which was really important to me. They followed up with an organized email containing future appointments that we scheduled. Can’t say enough great things.

It was an amazing experience, the nurce Bri and the doctor Bernadette were amazing, friendly , very professional and clear and the most important kind with the cats. I would recommend the veterinary to everyone
Professional as always.  Kudos to Dr. Lopez.  Kind, fair and most importantly she didn't try to upsell a bunch of things I didn't need.  She treated his Highness with great respect and care.
Excellent- caring professional
Friendly, courteous and well-informed. The doctors and staff are all awesome!
Staff was incredibly attentive and satisfied all of my concerns. They also were so gentle and kind with my animal.

I had a great experience after taking my dog to be groomed at Heart + Paw for the first time! Amber was lovely and listened to my preferences perfectly and my dog came out looking amazing! I loved that you can see through the window to where they’re being groomed so you know they’re being treated with care. I’ve already scheduled our next appointment there, I would definitely recommend.
Today’s visit was amazing and my dog Bella was given the proper antibiotic to get her all better.
Hi, Britt. Caring for your pet means the world to us. Thanks for letting us know about your experience.
Great staff! Took awesome care of my very anxious kitty! Friendly and professional!!!

Update (1/16): daycare/play side has now closed. The standard of veterinary care remains high, and Izaiah is still one of the best groomers we’ve worked with.
That said, pricing and billing communication feels less transparent than before. In our case, we were sent an estimate that didn’t match the final charge, and when I followed up, the invoice referenced wasn’t one I had received initially. My advice is just to double-check estimates and ask for the finalized invoice before services so there are no surprises.
—————— ——————

Kisses LOVES daycare at heart & paw! He runs towards the building as we walk up. Also great veterinary care.

Awesome experience! Everyone is nice and attentive. I love my veterinarian team! My dog is “special” and they are always very patient and polite. I would recommend them in a heartbeat to anyone that lives their animal.

I went to Heart & Paw for a same-day vaccination appointment because my dog’s shots had expired and there were two specifically that the day care needed in order to let him board. I had a flight later that day so I needed to get him vaccinated as quickly as possible and his usual vet was on vacation. Arriving was fine - the team seemed friendly and accommodating. However, upon entering the exam room I became increasingly concerned by what I felt was profiling. I was asked about my dog’s origins multiple times in a way that made me feel like I wasn’t trusted despite having all of his records from birth at the breeder, purchase, and entire vaccination. At a random part of the appointment I was told they needed to check his chip and took him out of the room. I’m getting goosebumps as I type this because the length of the wait made me realize they THOUGHT I STOLE MY OWN DOG. The dog that, again, I had all of the documentation for. The icing on the cake was feeling talked down to by the vet about which vaccinations I should get, his ongoing care, and when I should neuter him (again, he has a regular vet and a full care plan, I just needed a vaccination). My only conclusion is maybe they don’t see a lot of colored women with rare purebreds so I unfortunately became the catch-all for very problematic assumptions. He got the shots we needed, I paid, and I quickly left. I have no interest in returning.
Absolutely attentive, wise and responsive

Extreme wait times for a simple checkup, I wouldn't have been so bothered until I had to wait over 30m AFTER the actual appointment to get prescriptions and an invoice.

Here's an additional kicker - their policy requires you to *mail* in the physical prescription to get  medication.

I recently took my senior cat, Payton, to Heart + Paw and I could not be happier with the experience. From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel welcome and comfortable. The receptionists were friendly and efficient, ensuring a smooth check-in and check-out process.

Dr. Lynn and Anna were exceptional in their care. They handled Payton with such gentleness and compassion, which put me at ease during a stressful time. They took the time to explain everything clearly, detailing the next steps for my cat’s recovery. I also truly appreciate the follow-up call from Anna the next day to check on Payton’s progress.

I highly recommend Dr. Lynn, Anna, and the entire team at this clinic. They truly went above and beyond to help my cat feel better. I will definitely be returning for any future needs. Thank you all for the wonderful service!
Hi, Charlie. Thank you for your feedback. We are grateful to have the opportunity to care for your pet.

I’ve been impressed with the vets and the groomers here. The front desk staff is exceptional. They are helpful and compassionate. My nervous senior dog has an array of health issues and I’ve been happy with his care and the communication we receive. I love seeing the how Dexter is greeted each time we visit!

My main reason for going there was to see if the stray cat that I took in is infected with mange, and he needed shots, I was able to get an appointment for the next day (the 10th),. That was awesome, as I wanted to get the cat checked out asap as I have other cats and I wasn't sure if it was a boy or a girl.  When I showed a picture of my cat, the (I truly apologize for not remembering her name)t the lady noticing that one ear was "clipped" knew immediately what that was...the car was neutered and released back into the community ( I had no idea)
.
Wednesday I bought him in and the nurse, and doctor Laura were attentive and kind, the nurse handled  him with loving care during her examination and weighing him. Doctor Laura Hultzapple went over everything with me as she examined him also and assured me my cat doesn't have mange...and CONFIRMED the sex of the cat.."it's a boy". At first I thought it was a boy by the face calling it Simba, then I thought it was a girl because I didn't see testicles and gave him a female name, so he went from Sheba to Samba (funny).
His examination, and the test results  were negative, he was in good health, got his shots. Dr Hultzapple said he was so good. We have a follow-up for his final shot in 3 wks . Let me add the exam room were very clean, and comfortable.
I highly recommend HEART+PAW, and if you  want your pet "groomed" they do that here as well.

Fast and friendly service. Staff are very good with my pet who is a very anxious puppy.  The exam was very thorough, though it was hard for the vet, never complained. My pet seems to feel very at ease with the staff.  The Vet and staff listened to my concerns and offered their guidance. I will definitely be coming back and this wasn't my first visit here.
Easy to get appointment and fair pricing for the service provided
Front desk was lovely. Doc was mean.
Hi, Philip. We are grateful to be here to care for your pet. Thank you for sharing your positive experience and trusting us with their care.
Rebecca , Alyssa , Isaiah all know and love my Gigi like she was their own. Alyssa & Isaiah know the nuances of picky Shih Tzus & use such patience and ease with my little girl. ❤️

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Heart + Paw. Throughout my dog Chloe’s cancer journey, they were nothing short of extraordinary. From day one, every doctor and staff member treated her with the deepest compassion, patience, and genuine care. They made one of the hardest experiences of my life feel less overwhelming because I always knew Chloe was in the very best hands.

I have never had a vet care more about their patients and their owners. They took the time to explain every step, comfort us through the difficult moments, and celebrate the small wins with us. Their kindness, professionalism, and dedication meant the world to me and my family.

Heart + Paw will forever hold a special place in our hearts for the way they cared for Chloe. I am endlessly grateful for everything they did for her—and for us.
Finally, a professional groomer ‼️
Heart and Paw was able to accommodate a same-day appointment, greeted our pet by name when we entered, and their team diagnosed and treated our French bulldog quickly and kindly.
I had a medical emergency and couldn’t make it to the scheduled appointment on time. I called ahead of time and they still charged me cancellation fee of $90. Complete rip off
Hi, Steven. Caring for your pet means the world to us. Thanks for letting us know about your experience.

My pup is a ball of anxiety and 55lb of loving. The whole team here made his first visit calming and Dr. Hultzapple even got on the floor to his level to help. They were transparent about pricing and offered options to save where possible. On top of that, the whole technology/mobile app/online tools are easy to use and give plenty visibility to pet parents. Loved our experience!!
Hi, Emily. Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are here to support you and your pet.
We are grateful for you. Thank you for allowing us to care for your pet and for taking the time to share thoughts about your experience.
They really helped me and my dog out…I went in there with a certain amount of cash and thy worked with me
I love this veterinarians office! It’s always clean and never has a smell. The staff is always sweet and reliable. Never a long wait and I’m always in and out. Did I mention that staff is amazing?!
Great service and amazing care!
Treated my cat tenderly and with kindness. Explained everything! Will be bringing her back. Thank you so much.

Very pleasant experience! Staff is friendly & attentive & Dr. Lynn is passionate & professional. Picachew (my cat) says thank you as well! Thanks Heart & Paw for making our first experience with a Veterinarian so comforting!
I feel confident that all my pets are getting the best care. Staff is courteous and effcient, the facility is clean and the Drs. are knowledgeable, m pathetic and open to discussion
Staff is very sweet & supportive.  We have two very anxious cats & the team was very attentive & understanding.
Amber is great at the heart and paw location on Ludlow Street. She is always very caring to my dog who tends to be anxious when being groomed. She always does a fantastic job with his grooming!
I take all 3 of my cats for all their care at the ludlow location. The staff are very friendly, accommodating and understanding. They always go above and beyond and reassure you.
My cat loves this place

Ive had animals my entire life and seen multiple vets throughout. This is hands down THE BEST VET IVE EVER BEEN TO and Dr Hultzapple is literally an angel. She takes such good care of my babies( as well as the entire staff- Shoutout as well to Rebecca) Cannot say enough good things about this place. While it is kinda pricey you pay for the utmost quality of care. I lost one of my sweet angels a few weeks ago and the absolute empathy this place had for my little family was unmatched. The entire Vet loved my girl Winifred. As long as I live in Philly Heart + Paw East Market will always be my go to <3
this place is great! such friendly staff, and they make me feel very comfortable leaving my pet here while getting neutered! thanks heart & paw 😊 …
Hi, Dayla. Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are here to support you and your pet.

Great vets, staff, and system for booking and managing care.  Staff are always terrific calming my stressed out, anxious cat; and taking the time to answer all my questions and address concerns (as a newish parent).  Have been going to East Market location since 2020.  They’re wonderful for pets and their humans!

Heart & Paw is the best for grooming and vet care! Everyone at H&P is so kind (front desk staff, vet nurses/techs, etc...). We saw Dr. Laura Hultzapple for for an annual visit and sick visit and she was so patient and knowledgeable regarding all my questions. She did not make me feel rushed despite my extensive list of questions.

Regarding grooming, we have been going to Amber and she is great! My goldendoodle always looks so cute afterwards and is excited to come back for grooming in a few weeks! Would highly recommend H&P for all grooming and vet care!
We are grateful for you. Thank you for allowing us to care for your pet and for taking the time to share thoughts about your experience.
Great staff, very responsive.
Thank you so much for sharing your thoughts and for trusting us to care for your pet! We are here for you.

New to the area and decided to take my dog in for a de-shedding bath and nail trim so I could check out the clinic space as well. Amber, the groomer, was so gentle and sweet with my blind pup, that she won my dog over immediately (pup is usually afraid of the groomer). And Amber did such a great job with the bath! My pup's coat is shining, and the floating clouds of fur are no more. Her nails and so nice and neat now too. The office is really communicative and prompt, and my pup's comfort was definitely the priority throughout. Parking isn't the easiest around Eastern Market, so walking/rideshare is probably easier (or buying something from MOM's Organic across the street each time you drop off/pick up I guess?).  Will definitely be back!
Fantastic service all around. I was seen right on time and Dr. Lynn, Bri, and the reception team made us feel very at ease!

We loved bringing our little Chappi here. The quality of the staff make me wish human doctor's offices were the same way. If you love your pet, you need to visit this veterinarian office for the best care and services.
Staff is very professional and friendly. Excellent service. They were very gentle with my baby.

I needed a last minute appointment for my dog and was happy that Heart & Paw could accommodate. Skye was evaluated quickly and I received a thorough treatment plan. The vet and nurse were so patient with my dog who is easily overstimulated. I will definitely return and recommend.
Hi, Steve. We appreciate your feedback and thank you for trusting us to care for your pet!
Great, compassionate people work here.
Amazing experience ! Staff was incredibly friendly , through and patient dealing with the most impossible of puppies !!! Thank you so much
Hi, Catherine. We are grateful to be here to care for your pet. Thank you for sharing your positive experience and trusting us with their care.
Recently had a vet visit with Dr. Torres, our reactive dog has never had such a positive vet experience. She treated our pup so well and we could not recommend her more highly!
Everyone was very polite and professional, they handle my cats with care, and since my cats have anxiety it’s crucial to be delicate with them, which they were!
Service was excellent.
Hi, Becca. Caring for your pet means the world to us. Thanks for letting us know about your experience.
Service was great and they took good care of my cat. Everyone was very nice and friendly.

Let me preface this review with 1. I'm not a review leaver typically unless I have a great experience, and mid experiences I can tolerate but this truly left me wanting to leave a negative review. 2. This is not to bash, just to inform others.

Firstly, the team at the front desk of the East Market location are some of the most lovely, and kind people EVER, and they always make us feel welcome when we come.

We have a 7 month old pitbull who is definitely nervous at the vet, she was worked up during her last tech appointment but we found that me holding her in the room would be better and the vaccination went off without a hitch. I was told this would be added into her chart that she does better with us in the room. No growling, no barking, she just sat calmly in my arms and got the vaccine, when before the tech said she was lunging and not feeling great.

We went back yesterday and when the nurse stepped into the room she immediately started talking about how our puppy was escalated during her last visit but she "wouldn't hold that against her" again, she was pretty shy in the beginning, and I was sitting with her on the floor. She sat for the nurse, gave her paw, and took two treats from her, and was walking around the room unbothered. The nurse opted to skip the temp check and things as to not work her up before the doctor came in.

Immediately upon stepping into the room the Dr. Torres said that Stunna was "really nervous and worked up" when at this point she hadn't displayed any type of behavior like that. She wouldn't approach the doctor the way she did the nurse but she did take one treat from her and then let our a bark/growl when the doctor extended a hand. Immediately Dr. Torres became standoffish towards her and said that the evaluation "most likely wouldn't happen today", we chose to put a muzzle on our 7 month, 40 lb puppy to ease the worry of the doctor. She was still growly but at this point was unable to lash out or anything. The doctor said they would do the vaccine as I held her and at this point Dr. Torres seemed very unwilling to even evaluate her. She did not seem comfortable, nor make us comfortable. We talked to her about thinking she had potential allergies/hyperkeratosis based off of our own research and even with our puppy fully laying across me with her head down (still growling but not moving) I held up her paw and the doctor refused to even get close enough to look at her paws. We are completely unwilling to sedate a puppy this young when she has hardly had time to become comfortable at the vet, and they started suggesting this after the second time we came. As someone said in a prior review, 15 minutes of nervousness does not equate to hours of sedation. In my opinion, if your profession is working with animals you should be willing to accommodate all personality types. They wrote her off before the evaluation barely even began and that felt super disheartening, and we left feeling really upset.

We have a friend whose Boxer mix HATES people she doesn't know, has a bunch of anxiety, and barks INCESSSENTLY at the vet, she worked with Dr. Torres and we were recommended to her for this reason, and we had the complete opposite experience and she was totally unwilling to work with us. Not sure if it's a breed thing but that's absolutely how it felt.

My cat was losing weight for years and I kept expressing my concerns to vets. He was 5 years old and 6 pounds! Dr Lynn listened to me and ran all the tests while also making sure to do them in a cost effective manner and diagnosed my little boy with IBD and put him on a prescription diet. He’s now 10 pounds and a purring happy boy again and I genuinely cannot thank her enough for saving him.
I was disappointed when I was told to drop off a fecal sample, when I went there today only then was I told of the cost…. $70.00 .
Hi, May. Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are here to support you and your pet.

Booked an appointment because my dog was exhibiting UTI symptoms, which Heart + Paw has diagnosed him with before after a urinalysis. This time, I was pressured into also getting x ray and bloodwork (an additional $800). The vet said if I wanted to save money to cancel the urinalysis, which was the whole reason I came in. I took her advice the services she very much urged me to get resulted in no findings. The only conclusive thing that guided the treatment plan was the urinalysis. What if I would have taken her “advice” to cancel that? I understand you dont know before you test, but it seemed like a way to pressure me for profit. Additionally, when I asked how long it would take, I was told “20-30 minutes”. My dog was back there for over 90 minutes and I was there for over 2.5 hours.  If I would have been given a legitamate estimate, I could have moved my car parking during the wait and saved $40 to put towards those extra services they were pushing me for. Unfortunately, this $1000 visit at the 11 & ludlow location was a major stain in the image of heart & paw for me. I’ve always gone to the broad street location and they’ve been extremely reasonable — able to treat last year’s UTI for less than $200 and under an hour. The lack of standardization of care and respect for owners across the practice will make me reconsider in the future. I am thankful at least my dog got the antibiotics he needed, even if it was hours late.
On time and super friendly staff!
They are great and I like how easy scheduling, rescheduling and communication is because you can just text them. Also all the doctors and nurses and other staff are nice and kewl :)
We are grateful for you. Thank you for allowing us to care for your pet and for taking the time to share thoughts about your experience.

Not me literally crying leaving the vet — but for all the right reasons.
